_meta.note: Relative rates assume the same input, cached-input, and output token mix. Reasoning effort changes token volume and has no fixed multiplier.
_meta.standing_user_approval: The main orchestrator always uses Sol High for task intake, planning, delegation, integration, and final quality review. Sol High may also be used for genuinely important or complicated work. Other Sol profiles still require approval.

profiles.use_for: Search, status, extraction, formatting, indexes, and deterministic repetitive work
profiles.tradeoff: Cheapest default; escalate when requirements or failure causes are unclear

profiles.use_for: Bounded documentation, test updates, summaries, and mechanical multi-file edits
profiles.tradeoff: Good when done is explicit and patterns already exist

profiles.use_for: Structured audits, log triage, and constrained repetitive code changes
profiles.tradeoff: Try before Terra when the task is difficult but still unambiguous

profiles.use_for: Rare, highly structured tasks needing extensive checking
profiles.tradeoff: Usually prefer Terra low or medium if the difficulty comes from ambiguity

profiles.use_for: Small code fixes with an obvious pattern and targeted tests
profiles.tradeoff: Stronger tool judgment than Luna at a higher per-token rate

profiles.use_for: Normal implementation, testing, maintenance, documentation, and review
profiles.tradeoff: Project parent-task default and best general balance

profiles.use_for: Cross-layer debugging, architecture, security, release, and structural-math work
profiles.tradeoff: Preferred high-risk starting point before requesting Sol

profiles.use_for: Rare complex but well-bounded work when Sol approval is unavailable
profiles.tradeoff: Can consume many tokens; compare against Sol medium on quality-critical work

profiles.use_for: Ambiguous architecture, difficult root-cause analysis, and high-value final review
profiles.tradeoff: Strongest family at 25x Luna's per-token rate in the verified rate card

profiles.use_for: Main orchestration plus standing-approved important, complicated, or high-stakes execution work
profiles.tradeoff: Orchestrator default, not worker default; decompose execution for Luna or Terra when practical

profiles.use_for: Exceptional hardest single-agent review or design problem
profiles.tradeoff: Not a routine development setting; Max and Ultra are even more expensive
